subject: Re: MAP draft & timeline — Acme Healthcare deployment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@acmehealth.com>, Acme Healthcare Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call MAP draft & next steps — Acme Healthcare

Hi Dana / Procurement team,

Great to meet today — thanks for the time. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we discussed. Key points and proposed milestones below; please review and flag any missing dependencies or owners.

High-level summary (proposed):
- Target close date: 2026-03-31
- Key milestones (owner / dependency / target date):
  1) Procurement review & redlines (Acme Procurement / legal review) — target: 2026-02-19
  2) Security & risk questionnaire completion (Acme Sec/Risk + Redwood) — target: 2026-02-24
  3) Technical POC (Redwood + Acme infra) — target: 2026-03-10 (depends on sandbox access)
  4) Pricing & final SOW sign-off (procurement + Redwood Sales) — target: 2026-03-20
  5) Contract signature / go-live plan (exec sponsor) — target: 2026-03-31

Actions / next steps:
- Dana / Procurement: review attached MAP and SOW draft, confirm owners and any required procurement constraints.
- Marissa: update MAP with any changes and circulate final for signatures.
- Rishi/Dev: prepare POC runbook & sandbox access instructions once procurement timeline confirmed.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v3.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW-draft.pdf (pricing + SOW).

If the team prefers, we can break the MAP into two phases (security + procurement first, functional POC after contract) — call this out if you'd like to reprioritize.

Thanks — talk soon.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Healthcare Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP draft & next steps — Acme Healthcare

Marissa,

Thanks for the draft — appreciate the clear milestones. Quick update on our side: procurement has a couple of timing constraints this quarter and we need to push the procurement review / signature window out by a few weeks.

Proposed changes from Acme:
- Move target close date to 2026-04-21 (internal budget cycle shifted).
- Prioritize Security & Risk questionnaire earlier — procurement wants answers before routing to legal.
- Defer the technical POC until after we have basic contract terms agreed; we can do a lightweight demo in the interim.

Can you reprioritize the MAP so "Security questionnaire" is step 2 and procurement review follows once we feed answers into your risk team? Also include any items you need from us for the security questionnaire (e.g., SOC2 evidence, network diagrams).

I'll loop in Procurement for exact timelines; procurement@acmehealth.com will send their redline window.

Thanks,
Dana
Head of Partnerships, Acme Healthcare
Dana.Brooks@acmehealth.com

Subject: Updated MAP priorities & revised timeline (per your note)

Thanks Dana — appreciate the heads up on the budget timing. Per your request I reprioritized the MAP and updated target dates. Draft summary below; full updated MAP and revised SOW link attached.

Updated summary (new targets):
- New target close date: 2026-04-21

Updated milestones (owner / dependency / new target date):
  1) Security & Risk questionnaire (Acme Sec/Risk + Redwood SRE) — owner: Acme Sec / contact: Dana Brooks — dependency: RBC evidence reqs — target: 2026-02-26
  2) Procurement review & redlines (Acme Procurement) — owner: Acme Procurement — dependency: completed security questionnaire answers — target: 2026-03-12
  3) Legal / commercial negotiation (Redwood Sales + Acme Legal) — owner: Marissa / Acme Legal — target: 2026-03-22
  4) Technical POC / sandbox (Redwood Platform + Acme Dev) — owner: Dev Patel (Redwood) / Acme Dev — dependency: sandbox access; target: 2026-03-29 (lightweight demo available earlier)
  5) Final SOW sign-off & contract signature — owner: Exec sponsor / procurement — target: 2026-04-21

Dependencies / notes:
- For the security questionnaire we will need SOC2 Type II report, data flow diagram, and confirmation on where PHI will be processed/stored. If you can share those items (even just pointers), we can get the risk team moving.
- Dev: we will prepare a POC scope that minimizes data exposure until contract is in place. Rishi will scope any credit/discount for timeline shift.

Next steps (action owners):
- Dana / Acme Sec: send SOC2 and network diagram by 2026-02-20.
- Acme Procurement: confirm redline window by 2026-02-23.
- Marissa: circulate MAP v4 and updated SOW by 2026-02-18 (linked).
- Dev: prepare sandbox provisioning checklist and initial POC runbook by 2026-02-25.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v4.xlsx (updated MAP) — link: https://docs.example.com/drive/Redwood_MAP_Draft_v4; SOW-rev2.pdf (pricing adjustments).

Please confirm that the new dates work for your team, and if you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute alignment call with Procurement this week.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Marissa — noted. If the close slips to 4/21 we should be prepared to offer a timing credit for the delayed POC (I can run numbers). Also - add a one-off SLA clause for the Dedicated deployment in the SOW to address Acme's uptime concerns.

I'll coordinate with Finance on a proposed credit and send to you by EOD Monday. Dev — please start a POC runbook draft and list what minimal infra we need from Acme for sandbox access.

Rishi

Dana / team,

Thanks again for the update — attaching MAP v4 and SOW rev2 per our thread. Highlights:
- New target close: 2026-04-21
- Reprioritized step: Security questionnaire moved before procurement review
- POC: re-scoped as a lightweight demo until contracting is finalized; full sandbox POC scheduled after signature
- Action items and owners are embedded in MAP v4; I've also added a dependencies column for clarity.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v4.xlsx, SOW-rev2.pdf

Please confirm approval of the new timeline by 2026-03-25 so we can lock provisioning and internal credits. If approved, proposed next milestone: schedule procurement redline window (week of 2026-03-01) and a canary rollout target for June.

If helpful I'll set a short call to walk through the MAP and the updated SOW.

Best regards,
